entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4688970798174366464 (Gaia Collaboration 2023, A&A 674, A1), ICRS at epoch J2016.0, from the archived row src/objects/ogle-smc-ecl-1421-a/source/photometry/gaia-dr3-source.csv. Distance: Graczyk et al. (2020), ApJ 904, 13, the distance to OGLE-SMC-ECL-1421: 62.03 +/- 0.64 kpc (https://arxiv.org/abs/2010.08754): 62030 +/- 640 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.0577 +/- 0.0521 mas (same row, RUWE 1.06), 1.1 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 0.542, -1.182 mas/yr. Radial velocity: No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 4688970798174366464 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 20,000,000 of its distance per century (https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr/simbad/sim-id?Ident=Gaia%20DR3%204688970798174366464).

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,395 K and log g 2.37 (u1 0.522, u2 0.218): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
